title: ITTEN overrides
description: A project's departures from its system and from ITTEN's rules, one entry each, with the reason. Kept as itten.overrides.json at the project's root; docs/itten-overrides.md is rendered from it by scripts/overrides.js. scripts/telemetry.js reads these files across projects to find rules that many projects set aside.

rule.description: The rule set aside, by its ID in protocol/03-craft.md or reference/, such as LAY-10 or CRF-16.

check.description: The inspector check that reports it, when there is one. Pair it with data-itten-ignore on the element.

selector.description: A CSS selector for the elements the override covers.

scope.description: Where the override applies when a selector cannot say it, such as "every chart label" or "print stylesheet".

value.description: What the system or the rule asks for.

reason.description: Why. A departure with a reason is a decision; one without is a defect (DEC-08).

floors.description: Whether the accessibility floors still hold where the override applies.

date.description: When the override was decided, as YYYY-MM-DD.

itten.description: The ITTEN version or commit the project was on when it decided, such as 0.3.0.
